automation_evidence.quote: evidence-grounded metadata extraction with explicit abstention, and schema mapping with program synthesis for dataset-specific converters. Both tasks are handled by large language model (LLM) agents.

evidence.quote: Each agent output must be grounded in verbatim source evidence.

practical_problems.note: quote-or-abstain extraction and selective human review; the packet reports no experiment measuring residual error or abstention

evidence.quote: The admitted data must then pass a 26-rule validation gate covering schema consistency, statistical validity, and physical plausibility.

practical_problems.note: validation gate for curated data; no experiment varies or measures it in the packet

evidence.quote: temporal (early cycles train, late cycles test; forecasting under distribution shift), and cross-cell

practical_problems.note: benchmark declares temporal and cross-cell protocols but reports no results in the packet

summary: BatteryLake automates curation of battery time series with LLM agents and releases a SOH/RUL benchmark with three split protocols; the packet reports no experiments or results.
